Marta: Quick decision needed: May marketplace canary wave. Labs are constrained; propose prioritizing which SKUs (H100 / H200 / B200 / MI300 / Gaudi).

Sanjay: Prioritize H100 + Gaudi in US-west, MI300 in EU. H200/B200 as follow-ons.

Laura: Lab counts: us-west=6 usable nodes, apac=3, eu=9 but 5 blocked until Tue. H100 at 8x per node is infeasible unless we lower density.

Kevin: Vendors want an official canary SKU list today for driver signoff scheduling.

Marta: Draft plan: H100 (US-west limited, lower density), Gaudi (US-west), MI300 (EU post-unblock), H200 (APAC small), B200 (deferred).

Laura: Ops ok if H100 starts at 4x then steps to 8x. I'll produce staggered manifests.

Sanjay: Reserve 2 us-west nodes as fallback. Rollback triggers: P95 latency > baseline +20% or error rate >1%.

Marta: Actions: Laura create manifests; Sanjay reserve fallback nodes and write rollback thresholds; Kevin send SKU list + compatibility matrix request to vendors.

InfraBot: Pre-smoke run scheduled 2026-05-03T14:00Z. Results will post to #eng-oncall.

Kevin: Sending vendor note in ~1h with ETA ask for driver builds and requested kernel tags.

Marta: Tentative canary windows: US-west 2026-05-04, EU (MI300) 2026-05-06, APAC 2026-05-08. Lock at noon if no objections. :thumbsup:
